title: How the world live in my Nintendogs Creature Like
author: Sky782a
selftext: Just a show of my new Game when you pick an egg in a world that evolve and you take care of your creature

replies.author: Sky782a
replies.body:
Basically, it’s a game with a top-down map where you collect creature eggs and take care of them until they hatch. You need to clean the eggs and look after them.

Once they hatch, the creatures go to a sanctuary, where you have to walk them, wash them, and generally take care of them.
It's a Nintendogs+créature+ some crafting mechanic game
